fields.climate: Mediterranean along coast; dry, extreme desert interior
fields.terrain: mostly barren, flat to undulating plains, plateaus, depressions
fields.hazards: hot, dry, dust-laden ghibli is a southern wind lasting one to four days in spring and fall; dust storms, sandstorms
fields.farm: potatoes, onions, watermelons, tomatoes, dates, olives, milk, chicken, wheat, vegetables
fields.exports: crude petroleum, natural gas, refined petroleum, gold, scrap iron
fields.industries: petroleum, petrochemicals, aluminum, iron and steel, food processing, textiles, handicrafts, cement
fields.languages: Arabic (official), Italian, English (all widely understood in the major cities); Tamazight (Nafusi, Ghadamis, Suknah, Awjilah, Tamasheq)
fields.religions: Muslim (official; virtually all Sunni) 96.6%, Christian 2.7%, Buddhist <1%, Hindu <1%, Jewish <1%, folk religion <1%, other <1%, unaffiliated <1%
fields.legal: Libya's post-revolution system is in flux and driven by state and non-state entities
